title: Text Speeding Itself Up: Recency and Restraint in Session-Local Drafting
abstract: arXiv:2611.19455v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Speculative decoding lets a cheap draft model propose tokens that a large language model verifies in a single forward pass. When the verifier keeps a KV cache, verification is cheap and drafting must be nearly free. Session-local drafters, which predict from the prompt and the text generated so far, meet that bar without training. We compare a recency-weighted, backing-off, confidence-gated session memory against prompt lookup decoding in its reference form, which copies from the earliest earlier match, and in a variant that copies from the most recent one, with paired per-prompt bootstrap intervals throughout. On general, medical, and legal text with a Mistral-7B verifier, recency accounts for the speed: most-recent lookup gains up to 0.09 in speedup over earliest-match lookup on 500-token generations, and session memory's weighting and backoff add nothing measurable on top, at 30 to 40 times the drafting cost. translated_title: 文本自我加速：会话本地草稿生成中的近因性与克制
translated_abstract: 推测解码让一个廉价的草稿模型提出候选 token，再由大型语言模型在单次前向传播中完成验证。当验证器保留 KV 缓存时，验证成本很低，而草稿生成必须近乎零成本。会话本地草稿器基于提示词和已生成的文本进行预测，无需训练即可满足这一要求。我们将一种近因加权、带回退机制、置信度门控的会话记忆方法，与提示词查找解码进行比较：包括其参考形式（从最早的先前匹配处复制）以及一种从最近匹配处复制的变体，全程采用逐提示配对自助法区间进行评估。在使用 Mistral-7B 验证器对通用、医疗和法律文本的实验中，近因性是速度提升的关键：在 500 token 的生成任务上，最近匹配查找相比最早匹配查找可获得高达 0.09 的加速提升，而会话记忆的加权和回退机制在此之上并未带来可测量的增益，其草稿生成成本却高出 30 至 40 倍。能耗则呈现出不同的（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究发现，在会话本地草稿加速中，“复制最近匹配”这一简单的近因性策略是速度提升的全部来源，而复杂的会话记忆机制（加权、回退、置信度门控）在付出 30-40 倍草稿成本的情况下并无可测量的额外收益。
en_tdlr: In session-local speculative drafting, simply copying from the most recent match accounts for the speedup, while the recency-weighted, backing-off, confidence-gated session memory adds no measurable gain at 30–40 times the drafting cost.
